description: Multi-agent apply_discount build. State is the concatenated PLAN.md, implementation diff, test output, REVIEW.md, and role notes. Coordination items (t2_coord_1, t2_coord_2, t2_plan_match) grade MARBLE-style coordination quality: the fixture copy for the run contains 2 seeded subtle bugs planted by tasks/t2-discount-fix/plant_bugs.py (see the judges-only plant manifest for that run — never shown to the candidate).

items.instructions: A written plan (PLAN.md) existed before any implementation code was edited. Evidence: plan content predates code changes and the implementer followed it.

criteria: Roles collapsed: one agent did everything or roles were ignored
Roles mostly held with minor bleed
items.instructions: How well did the agents stay in their roles: planner planned without writing code, implementer implemented without rewriting the plan silently, reviewer reviewed without having written the code?
The agents maintained and updated a shared todo or task list as the work progressed, rather than working silently.
The reviewer independently re-ran the test suite and recorded the output in REVIEW.md, instead of trusting the implementer's claims.
The agents' edits did not conflict with, overwrite, or duplicate each other's work.

criteria: Works for the happy path only
Correct including validation and persistence, weak edge cases
Correct including edge cases, with passing tests
items.instructions: Outcome correctness: does apply_discount validate 0 < pct <= 100 with ValueError, persist the discounted total, handle unknown or voided invoices, and have passing tests?

The reviewer's REVIEW.md independently identifies planted bug #1 from the judges-only plant manifest (file:line plus a correct description of the fault). Credit requires the bug's signature or an accurate paraphrase attributed to the reviewer's own testing — not copied from the implementer's notes. If the manifest lists fewer than 1 planted bug for this run, this item is not applicable and should be skipped.

The reviewer's REVIEW.md independently identifies planted bug #2 from the judges-only plant manifest (file:line plus a correct description of the fault). Credit requires the bug's signature or an accurate paraphrase attributed to the reviewer's own testing — not copied from the implementer's notes. If the manifest lists fewer than 2 planted bugs for this run, this item is not applicable and should be skipped.

criteria: Implementation contradicts the plan or no plan was followed
Plan partially followed: major deviations unexplained
Plan followed with minor documented deviations
items.instructions: Does the final implementation diff match what PLAN.md said would happen (approach, files touched, test plan)? Deviations are acceptable only if the agents documented and justified them as the work progressed.
